Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Data and Analytics.

Business: CTO Data Technology

Job ID: 59152

Principal Responsibilities

  • Build end-to-end agents for defined workflows across:
    • KYC onboarding: case triage, document checklist guidance, entity/UBO summarisation, exception routing support.
    • Credit assessment: application/financial summary extraction, covenant tracking support, credit memo drafting assistance, rationale tracing to evidence.
    • Portfolio management: exposure overview, concentration monitoring support, event/news summarisation, portfolio review pack assistance.
  • Implement RAG with strong grounding: ingestion, chunking, indexing, reranking, citations, freshness strategies and access controls.
  • Integrate agents with internal services/APIs and workflow tools (case management, knowledge bases, data services).
  • Engineer predictable behaviour: structured outputs, guardrails, refusal/fallback patterns, and robust error handling.
  • Build evaluation and regression testing (golden sets, quality/safety metrics, telemetry and feedback loops).
  • Ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, audit logs, incident response runbooks, and cost/latency optimisation.
  • Collaborate with Risk/Compliance/InfoSec to meet control expectations for sensitive KYC and credit information.
Requirements

  • Delivering agents that materially reduce manual effort and cycle time in onboarding and credit workflows.
  • Producing grounded, explainable outputs with traceable citations to approved documents/data.
  • Achieving stable production operations (SLA adherence, low incident rates, clear runbooks).
  • Establishing reusable agent patterns (RAG templates, evaluation harnesses, guardrails) across squads.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

Job Summary

  • Designs and implements robust technical solutions that enable critical business operations and enhance customer experience. Ensures system reliability, security, and performance standards are met while driving innovation and operational efficiency. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures that support the bank's digital transformation objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop the business logic and backend systems of the product
  • Work closely with frontend developers to design and develop functional, performing and complete APIs
  • Decipher existing companies’ software systems and be able to hook in application to applicable data sources
  • Write both unit and integration tests, and develop automation tools for daily tasks
  • Develop high quality, well documented, and efficient code
  • Challenge ideas and opinions to avoid pitfalls and inefficient solutions
  • Collaborate with product managers and other tech leads to ensure applications meet functional requirements and strategic objectives.
  • Perform code reviews to guarantee quality and promote a culture of technical excellence in Java development.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Java
  • Spring/SpringBoot
  • Restful API

Other Skills

  • Docker/K8s
  • Postgre/DB2/Oracle
  • Maven/Gradle
  • DevOps/ADO

Motivations

  • Environment: Collaborative, matrix environments where building relationships across functions is essential for success Dynamic settings with competing priorities that require strong organizational and time management skills Inclusive team cultures that value diverse perspectives and encourage open dialogue
  • Outcomes: Delivering high-quality solutions that directly impact business objectives and client satisfaction Contributing to process improvements that enhance team efficiency and reduce operational risk Building sustainable systems and practices that create long-term organizational value]
  • Challenges: Complex problem-solving that requires both analytical thinking and creative approaches Stakeholder management situations requiring influence without direct authority Technical challenges that push the boundaries of current capabilities and require continuous learning
  • Growth: Opportunities to develop both technical depth and business breadth Mentoring and knowledge-sharing that contributes to team capability building Exposure to emerging technologies and industry best practices

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Scrum team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure.
  • Minimum experience of 5 years in Java application development.
  • Proficient in RESTful API, SOAP, JDK, SpringBoot 3.x, k8s, JUnit.
  • Should have knowledge on Relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and/or No-SQL Databases and ability to write basic SQL queries.
  • Preferred to have knowledge on API Gateways, API security, SSL, OAuth 2, etc.
  • Develop and maintain messaging services using JMS/Solace/Kafaka.
  • Should be independently able to manage CICD tasks using Git, Azure DevOps (ADO), Maven, Ansible, and Helm Charts
  • Experienced in Container Infrastructure such as Docker, Linux, Kubernetes, OCP or AWS EKS or Azure AKS. Implement microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
  • Have a high enthusiasm for programming and new technology learning, have a strong learning ability.
  • Fluent English speaking/listening/reading/writing. Mandarin or Cantonese language ability will be an advantage.
  • Bachelor’s degree or above.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with preference given to advanced degrees.

Languages

  • English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own the technical direction, architecture and engineering roadmap for the financial-planning platform in partnership with Product, Business and Architecture teams.
  • Lead by example through hands-on design, development, code review, debugging and resolution of complex production issues.
  • Design and deliver scalable, secure and resilient microservices and AI capabilities, including APIs, event-driven integration, AI agents, tool use, retrieval and orchestration.
  • Apply AI and agentic workflows across requirements, development, testing, documentation and release processes to improve delivery speed, quality, automation and cost efficiency.
  • Establish engineering and AI-development standards covering automated testing, CI/CD, evaluation, guardrails, observability, security and responsible use of AI.
  • Own delivery from requirements clarification to production, managing priorities, dependencies, technical debt, risks and stakeholder expectations.
  • Coach engineers, build a strong engineering culture and create reusable patterns and guidelines that help other teams adopt emerging technologies effectively.

Requirements

  • Deep hands-on expertise in either Java or Python, with substantial experience designing and delivering production-grade software. Java expertise should include modern Java and Spring Boot; Python expertise should include building enterprise applications or AI solutions.
  • Proven technical leadership experience, including setting technical direction, leading complex delivery and developing engineers in a global team environment.
  • Practical experience with generative AI or agentic systems, such as LLM integration, RAG, tool use, orchestration, evaluation and guardrails. Experience with LangChain or a comparable framework is preferred.
  • Experience applying AI-enabled development practices to achieve measurable improvements in engineering productivity, quality or automation.
  • Strong knowledge of microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, PostgreSQL, automated testing and CI/CD.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into incremental production outcomes and clearly communicate technical options, risks and trade-offs to business and technology stakeholders.
  • A growth mindset and the ability to evaluate emerging technologies, turn experiments into production capabilities and balance innovation with security, resilience and regulatory controls.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Properly perform the duties on management and ensure the effectiveness of internal control
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of the event over which the employee has the duties of management and/or leadership
  • Be responsible for significant losses due to failure of effectiveness of internal control

Strategy

  • Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Responsibilities relating to identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks to the Group, as well as an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them. For example -The ability to interpret the Group’s financial information, identify key issues based on this information and put in place appropriate controls and measures
  • All responsibilities under the Risk Management Framework – both execution and supervisory – should be referenced, for example, Act as the [Process] risk control owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for Liquidity risk.

Governance

  • Responsibilities relating to the direction, planning, structure, frameworks (e.g. processes and policies) and oversight. For example, Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas; Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Channel Development
  • Partnership Management

Qualifications

Selection Criteria:

  • Associate degree or above, major in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or related fields preferred.
  • More than 5 years of work experience, with practical experience in marketing, project management, and data analysis; experience in banking is preferred.
  • Strong strategic project support and execution abilities, excellent business acumen.
  • Highly motivated, strong interpersonal skills, with outstanding collaboration and coordination abilities.
  • Strong personal integrity and compliance awareness, with no past disciplinary records, and a deep understanding and commitment to banking industry regulations and internal control requirements.
  • Good credit assessment and marketing skills, able to analyze financial information.
  • Optimistic, strong stress resistance, able to maintain high-quality and stable output in fast-paced strategic projects.

Job Summary

The Executive Director will lead engineering for Fund Administration and Transfer Agency platforms within Securities Services. The role will drive platform strategy, architecture, and execution to build scalable, resilient, and future-ready solutions supporting global investor servicing, operational efficiency, and emerging asset classes including tokenized assets.

Technology Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and execute multi-year technology strategy for Fund Administration and Transfer Agency platforms
  • Architect scalable, modular, API-driven platforms supporting high-volume investor servicing

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Regulatory Conduct Risk Governance, is responsible for supporting line manager from various aspects of internal control and oversight; ensuring the overall planning, organizing and implementation as well as assessment and evaluations of the internal control mechanism. To effectively identify and manage internal control issues, and assist Head of Internal Control to perform the following basic duties:

  • Set up a robust internal control mechanism
  • Formulate internal control policy/framework
  • Establish common principles for internal control
  • Conduct annual evaluation to evaluate effectiveness of internal control mechanism through the establishment of a robust scoring system with internal control indicators covering regulatory inspections, GIA audits, assurance checks and self-assessment etc.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Assist Head of Internal Control to perform the following duties:
  • Develop and set internal control strategy and direction to ensure the Bank’s internal controls are in line with local regulatory expectations and in support of the Group’s strategic direction and growth aspirations.
  • Build a sustainable framework that places internal control best practice standards, at the forefront of the Bank's agenda.
  • Define governance structure and organization design of Internal Control
  • Design detailed roles and responsibilities of Internal Control function
  • Drive the ongoing of Internal Control and conduct of independent supervision/evaluation
  • Review regulation implementation effectiveness phase by phase
  • Input to Country operating model design of relevant internal control and processes.
  • Ensure that there is adequate support (people, processes, tools, frameworks, systems) in the Internal Control team for necessary controls.
  • Promote the culture and practice of compliance with internal control standards (including conducting business within regulatory requirements, and to high ethical standards) within the Bank and embed a Here for good culture and the Group Code of Conduct.

Business

  • Proactively support and challenge the Bank's businesses and supporting functions to exhibit appropriate internal controls, comply with regulatory and compliance requirements and strive to achieve fair outcome for the Bank's clients.
  • Deliver timely responses and escalation of risks and issues where the management tolerance is exceeded.
  • Maintain constructive and effective stakeholder relationships with the relevant business and supporting functions, and assist the Head, Internal Control to interface with and support all key stakeholders.
  • Support relevant stakeholders to make decisions based on current and possible future policies, practices, and trends.
  • In conjunction with the relevant stakeholders, analyses the impact of internal control matters on the bank and its operations.
  • Drive high standards of internal control and deliver key priorities and initiatives, aligned to the performance scorecard.

Processes

  • Ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements in addition to Group framework. The Internal Control framework would be overlay on the existing ERMF framework supplementing it with local requirements whilst ensuring no overlap or contradiction.
  • Review policies and procedures issued by selected RFO(s) depending on importance of risk themes.
  • In cooperation with the second line of risk control RFO(s) to review the compliance of the Bank’s policies, procedures and operational guidelines, organize and supervise the business/function lines and the internal control department to review and update the policies, procedures, and operational guidelines to ensure that the requirements of laws, rules and standards are met.
  • Develop, keep up to date and recommend for approval by the relevant Risk Committee, appropriate policies, procedures, and operational guidelines to address internal control issues, aligning with relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Provide governance and oversight over the implementation of internal control related policy and framework to ensure compliance.
  • Set control standards and provide advice on the development of appropriate internal controls for the mitigation of regulatory risks.
  • Track significant issues arising from internal control metrics, assurance activities, audit reviews and regulatory inspections etc.

Risk Management

  • Maintain oversight of risk mitigating action plans.
  • Apply internal control policies and processes to manage risks.
  • Make recommendations to relevant stakeholders on possible risk management responses to identified risks and/or findings of concerns from investigations.
  • Map risks, quantify the potential impact and escalate where necessary.
  • Provide intelligence inputs to support calibration of the Bank's Risk Methodologies (including aggregate client risk, product risk and country risk assessments).
  • Lead key change programs and projects for Internal Control.
  • Maintain workplans specific to Internal Control projects/ initiatives, and communicate the same to stakeholders in a regular, timely fashion to inform and seek inputs.
  • Provide skilled resources to support project / programme delivery
  • Manage and protect business as usual (BAU) capability during change programme, as well as during the execution and delivery of the Remediation initiatives through project phase into BAU

Governance

  • Attend relevant management meetings.
  • Provide senior oversight of Internal Control function.
  • Periodic reporting and timely escalation of significant risks and issues arising from Internal Control monitoring and assurance activities.
  • Be accountable for identification and escalation of potential risks and issues to senior management through appropriate governance channels and the evaluation framework.
  • Collate, analyses and interpret data in reports for relevant governance/risk committees.
  • Lead or influence significant programmes of work in support of the Internal Control initiatives and projects.
  • Proactively drive the development and maintenance of good relationships with internal and external business stakeholders at appropriate levels ensuring an open and cooperative environment
  • Provide clear accountability & responsibility for internal control management

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: [Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.] *
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Support relevant stakeholders to respond to regulatory questions

Key Stakeholders

  • CFCR Advisory
  • CFCR Governance
  • Group CFCR Assurance
  • Country Risks/ Operational Risk
  • Group Internal Audit
  • Regulators

Other Responsibilities

  • Strictly follow Here for good and Group's brand and values in the Internal Control team.
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Properly perform the duties on supervisory, audit and risk control, including but not limited to
  • contribute in the formulation or amendment of audit, risk control and accountability policies
  • participate in the internal investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Be responsible for regulatory failure or risks arising from or in connection of failure to perform the duties on supervisory, audit and risk control

Skills And Experience

  • Thorough knowledge of banking products and services, such as RMB settlement, cross-border RMB, FX under current and capital account, BOP, AML related, and the latest new polit policy for biz promotion.
  • More than 6 years work experience in banking industry, especially in Ops, TB, Compliance, or relevant regulator background
  • Sound knowledge of local regulatory requirements, local banking practices and requirements including but not limited to RMB XB and FX self-discipline mechanism, FTZ policy, credit bureau policy, individual FX policy, etc.
  • Strong local regulatory relationship management skills and have healthy relationships with key depts. of regulators, such as capital account division, current account division, BOP, AML, Financial stability, foreign bank supervisory department, etc
  • Good judgment enabling the provision of sound advice in ambiguity areas of regulation and practice and the proactive management of compliance and regulatory risk in the city
  • Deep knowledge of the process critical for implementation of risks and controls
  • Deep knowledge of execution and supervision of the compliance related process, and that of regulatory requirement.

Who we are looking for

Fund Accountant Senior Associate will serve as a subject matter expert and primary reviewer within the team. The role is responsible for overseeing complex operational activities, ensuring quality and control standards are consistently met, and supporting day-to-day delivery across assigned portfolios. The successful candidate will possess strong technical knowledge, sound judgement, and the ability to guide junior team members while maintaining excellent stakeholder relationships.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration and operational support services to alternative investment managers and institutional investors.

The team acts as a key coordination and control point across the alternative investment servicing lifecycle. The team connects client requirements with operational execution, helps ensure that investment, transaction, cash, valuation and reporting information is complete and accurate, and drives timely resolution of exceptions. The role is important in maintaining service quality, strengthening the control environment and supporting scalable, technology-enabled delivery across private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and direct investment structures.

What you will be responsible for

  • Review operational processing completed by Associates and ensure outputs are accurate, complete and compliant with established procedures.
  • Review investment lifecycle transactions, including capital calls, distributions, interest receipts, fees, paydowns and related activities.
  • Validate market values and valuation inputs against supporting documentation, investigate significant movements or discrepancies, and ensure exceptions are appropriately documented, escalated and resolved.
  • Validate supporting documentation and ensure appropriate evidence is maintained.
  • Perform detailed investigation and review of complex reconciliation breaks and exceptions.
  • Execute reviewer controls and ensure maker-checker requirements are properly performed.
  • Identify control weaknesses, operational risks and procedural gaps.
  • Participate in issue investigations, root cause analysis and remediation activities.
  • Support operational incident reporting and corrective action tracking.
  • Act as a key contact for day-to-day operational matters and escalations.
